question:
The aqueduct repair crew is investigating a critical leak along the ancient water channels. The precise location of the leak must be identified in one of three sections.
Possible locations: Section Alpha, Section Beta, or Section Gamma.

Clues:
- (1) The water leak is not in Section Alpha.
- (2) The water leak is in Section Alpha.
- (3) The water leak is not in Section Beta.

RULE: Exactly 1 of these clues is true (all others are false).

Where is the water leak?
hints: Clue (1) and clue (2) are direct opposites, meaning one must be true and the other false. This establishes a relationship between clue (1) and clue (2) regarding their truthfulness.

If we examine Section Alpha, clue (1) would be false, and clue (2) would be true. Clue (3) would also be true. This scenario results in two true clues (clue (2) and clue (3)). This contradicts the rule that exactly one clue must be true, therefore Section Alpha cannot be the location of the water leak.

intermediate_trace.elimination_reason: Testing Section Alpha results in 2 true clues (clue (2), clue (3) are true) instead of exactly 1 true clue.
intermediate_trace.clue_insight: Clue (1) and clue (2) directly contradict each other: exactly one of them must always be true.

themed_clues: (1) The water leak is not in Section Alpha.
(2) The water leak is in Section Alpha.
(3) The water leak is not in Section Beta.
